user.title: Solis SDM630 Sniffer
user.description: Listen to raw binary traffic containing both Modbus requests and responses. No requests will be sent. Publish the latest sensor readings at the update interval (default 30 seconds). This also controls dashboard, automation, and history updates; availability changes are immediate. Optionally enter the IP address or hostname of the Solis S2-WL-ST logger to add read-only local inverter readings; leave it empty to skip. You can change it later under Configure.

meter.title: Meter
meter.description: Choose which sign of Total active power means grid import. This affects the grid import/export power sensors only; meter energy counters keep their original direction. Publish the latest sensor readings at the update interval (default 30 seconds). This also controls dashboard, automation, and history updates; availability changes are immediate.

logger.title: Inverter logger
logger.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of the Solis S2-WL-ST logger to add local inverter readings. The logger is only read (Modbus function 04); nothing is written to the inverter or logger, and SolisCloud reporting is not changed. Leave the address empty to disable polling.

utility_meters.title: Create utility meters
utility_meters.description: Create standard Utility Meter helpers for the selected cycles and sources. Existing matching helpers are kept, and nothing is recreated on restart. The first period starts when a helper is created. Estimated solar/household energy sources need a configured logger.
